other_conditions: Applicants must be Indian citizens residing in India or French citizens residing in France
Applicants must be registered for a PhD in a recognized Indian or French university/research institute (French applicants may also be registered for a Master’s program)
Candidates who have previously received CEFIPRA support or who hold a permanent position in an institution/university are ineligible
Pre‑authorization or prior consent from the applicant’s institute/university is required to apply for the foreign fellowship
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship (1500 € for Indian fellows or ₹40,000 for French fellows), round‑trip economy airfare, insurance, visa/registration costs, and conference support
